headline: 🔴 Cisco CVSS 10.0 Zero-Day, 📧 Exchange OWA Exploited, 🐧 Copy Fail Kernel LPE, 🤖 PraisonAI Exploited, 📞 BlackFile Vishing
summary: Cisco SD-WAN CVSS 10.0 zero-day with Metasploit module faces May 17 CISA deadline; Exchange Server OWA zero-day actively exploited with no permanent patch; Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) grants instant Linux root — third kernel page-cache LPE in three weeks; BlackFile/UNC6671 vishing campaign documented by Google GTIG; PraisonAI exploited hours after disclosure highlighting systemic AI platform insecurity.
